description: This file contains the styles for a tic-tac-toe game frontend, defining variables for colors and layout for different components including the game board, squares, and buttons.

classes.name: App
classes.description: The main application container that centers the content vertically and horizontally.

classes.name: game-title
classes.description: Styles for the game title, including color and font size.

classes.name: game-board
classes.description: Grid layout styles for arranging tic-tac-toe squares.

classes.name: square
classes.description: Styles for each square in the tic-tac-toe grid, including sizes and hover effects.

classes.name: status
classes.description: Styles for displaying the game status.

classes.name: reset-button
classes.description: Styles for the reset button, including hover effects.
